hints.title: Pairwise Deletion Invariant
hints.text: Each operation selects an occurrence and deletes two matching characters, one on the left and one on the right. Hence each operation reduces frequency by exactly two.

hints.title: Parity Reduction
hints.text: Repeatedly subtracting two from an odd frequency stops at one. Repeatedly subtracting two from a positive even frequency stops at two.

hints.title: Independent Summation
hints.text: Operations on distinct characters do not interfere with each other. Sum the final parity contributions across all distinct characters.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Alphabet size is bounded by 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating deletions directly mutates the string in O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed size frequency table needs O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduces frequency modulo arithmetic instead of simulating string deletions.
